item.title: ams OSRAM reports solid Q2, accelerates microLED arrays for AR smart glasses
item.summary: ams OSRAM has reported second-quarter revenue and profitability at the upper end of its guidance while moving its microLED array technology closer to mass-production readiness for next-generation augmented reality smart glasses. The company posted Q2 2026 revenue of €805 million, up 4% year over year, with an adjusted EBITDA margin of 16.9%.
